verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents built-in automations that run without manual action: auto-starting and auto-completing Epics, auto-creating future Iterations, and rolling unfinished Stories into the next Iteration. Integrations also update Shortcut automatically as work happens. These are fixed, predefined behaviors rather than user-built autonomous workflows. The REST API is only a developer building block, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation/rule builder, custom triggers and actions, agent-driven background automations, scheduling controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Auto-start and auto-complete an Epic, auto-create future Iterations, and move unfinished Stories to the next Iteration
Seamless integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and other tools mean Shortcut updates while you work.
